6. An oxyacid contains two hydrogen atoms, one sulphur atom and four oxy-
gen atoms. Write the formula of the compound formed by the negative rad-
ical of the acid with ferric ion.
(a) $\mathrm{Fe}_2(\mathrm{SO}_4)_3$ (b) $\mathrm{FeSO}_4$
(c) $\mathrm{Fe}_3(\mathrm{SO}_4)_2$ (d) $\mathrm{Fe}(\mathrm{SO}_4)_3$

7. If the volume occupied by a certain mass of gas is decreased to 70%, what
would be the percentage change in pressure at the same temperature?
(a) +57% (b) +70% (c) +35% (d) +43%

8. Which among the following constitutes the maximum number of atoms?
(a) $15 \times 10^{25}$ molecules of $\mathrm{SO}_3$
(b) $2.5 \times 10^{25}$ molecules of $\mathrm{SO}_2$
(c) $3 \times 10^{25}$ molecules of $\mathrm{O}_2$
(d) $2.5 \times 10^{25}$ molecules of $\mathrm{N}_2\mathrm{O}_5$

9. 300 mL of ethene is subjected to complete combustion. Calculate the volumes
of $\mathrm{O}_2$ required and $\mathrm{CO}_2$ produced under same conditions.
(a) 400 mL, 150 mL (b) 800 mL, 500 mL
(c) 450 mL, 300 mL (d) 900 mL, 600 mL
